articles.title: Kalshi now requires users to reveal employers as it fights insider trading and market manipulation
articles.snippet: The prediction markets platform introduced new measures on Tuesday that it said will apply to markets it considers are likely to face higher risks of insider trading and abuse.

articles.title: Prediction markets get first U.S. rule proposal as CFTC pursues contract reviews
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission opened a proposed rule for public comment that sets an approach to determine contracts in the "public interest."

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Index drops 1.4% as all constituents decline
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) fell 4.1% and NEAR Protocol (NEAR) shed 4.3%, leading the index lower.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Paradigm urge revision of GENIUS money-laundering rule
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Paradigm say the Treasury’s money-laundering rules for the GENIUS Act are too onerous for stablecoin issuers.

articles.title: 'Maximal' ban on insider trading would hurt prediction markets, says researcher
articles.snippet: “The same insider trade that improves the accuracy of the price today can reduce the participation that makes the price informative tomorrow,” said Balbinder Singh Gill.
